lines: Aye mohabbat, tere anjaam pe rona aaya
Aye mohabbat, tere anjaam pe rona aaya
couplets.en: O love, I wept at what became of you.

lines: Jaane kyun aaj tere naam pe rona aaya
couplets.en: Who knows why your name brought me to tears today.

lines: Yun to har shaam ummeedon mein guzar jaati thi
Aaj kuchh baat hai, jo shaam pe rona aaya
couplets.en: Evenings used to pass in hope, but something about this one made me weep.

lines: Aaj kuchh baat hai, jo shaam pe
couplets.en: There is something about this evening.

lines: Kabhi taqdeer ka maatam, kabhi duniya ka gila
couplets.en: Sometimes I mourned my fate, sometimes I blamed the world.

lines: Manzil-e-ishq mein har gaam pe rona aaya
couplets.en: On the road of love, every step brought me to tears.

lines: Jab hua zikr zamaane mein mohabbat ka, Shakeel
couplets.en: When people spoke of love, Shakeel.

lines: Mujh ko apne dil-e-naakaam pe rona aaya
Aye mohabbat, tere anjaam pe rona aaya
couplets.en: I wept for my thwarted heart and for what became of you, O love.
